title: Channel Digest
tagline: Created a Farcaster frame for trending channels and to get casts and statistics for the channel
description: Using frog.fm framework I created a multipage frame for a channel digest. Once a user starts on the frame they are able to view trending frames (from Neynar) and then asked to select the channel they want to look into. Then I used an LLM to summarize the recent casts of the frame and display it to the user. There are additional buttons where they can view the recent casts, and finally channel data is retrieved from Dune.
